messages:
Paul (Support): Heads up — escalating ticket SR-9821 to CS. Valence Health onboarding is blocked by SSO failures. They have a demo next week and renewal in ~45 days, so flagging renewal risk.
Maya (CS): Thanks Paul. Can you paste the exact error and confirm whether it's org-wide or just a few admin users?
Paul (Support): Error snippet: `AuthError: missing attribute 'eduPersonPrincipalName'`. Impact so far: 3 admins couldn't finish signup. We refreshed metadata and rotated keys, no change. Ticket has SAML metadata + screenshots. https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/SR-9821
Maya (CS): Copy. Sounds like attribute mapping / NameID. Who's their IT contact? If we need to re-run metadata, loop Solutions.
Tessa (Solutions Eng): I'm on it. Quick review of their metadata shows NameID format set to unspecified and no email attribute mapping. Two fixes: set NameID to `emailAddress` OR ensure `mail`/`email` is sent as an attribute. I can propose the exact IdP change and join a remediation call. Recommend a 1-hour enablement session with their IT.
Paul (Support): :thumbsup: They agreed to a call — Tue 9am PT works for them.
Oliver (CS Manager): Marking renewal risk as HIGH given timeline. Maya, please take lead on comms and owner of the customer-facing note. Playbook for this thread: 1) Triage and apply quick IdP patch, 2) Offer temporary invite bypass (time-limited), 3) Run enablement call, 4) Document fix and capture feedback for docs. CC Janet for enablement resources.
Maya (CS): I'll own comms. Drafting outbound now to confirm escalation and next steps. Proposed email bullets: - acknowledge issue + apology, - confirm kickoff with IdP + ETA (24h), - offer temp invites, - confirm enablement call time. Will paste the email in thread for review.
Janet (Enablement): I can run and script the enablement call and prepare an SSO troubleshooting checklist. Also noting they reported the migration guide as unclear — I'll log doc feedback and create a short PR after the call.
Tessa (Solutions Eng): I'll join call to apply IdP change and validate SAML attributes. After the call we should record an onboarding metric: success rate by account and common SSO failure modes.
Paul (Support): Note added to SR-9821: escalate to eng-oncall if SAML NameID mismatch isn't resolved during the call. Tagging ticket-bot for trace.
Maya (CS): Sent initial comms to customer and to AM Sarah Liu. Email copy (condensed): `Hi <Name>, we've escalated your SSO issue as a priority. We're scheduled to troubleshoot Tue 9am PT. We'll provide temporary invites if needed and follow up within 24h. —Maya`
Oliver (CS Manager): Good. Next sync in 24h. @Tessa @Janet confirm invites and prep. Also add renewal owner: Sarah Liu in tracker. :spiral_calendar:
Tessa (Solutions Eng): Invites sent to customer + internal. I'll prepare the patch notes and test steps.
Janet (Enablement): Created PR draft: /docs/enablement/sso-troubleshoot-draft.md — will request review from Maya. I'll include a one-page checklist for the call.
Maya (CS): Updating CS tracker: https://cs.redwood.ai/tracker/rows/9821 — risk level set to HIGH; renewal_owner: Sarah Liu.
Paul (Support): Thanks everyone — ticket SR-9821 updated with internal notes and upcoming call details.
Maya (CS): Will post a short post-call summary here after Tue session with outcomes and next actions.
file_note: Escalation thread: support -> CS for SSO onboarding block and renewal risk. Contains root and replies as single string.
